rationale: The voicemail nails core beats (identifies himself, rambles logistics, includes one buried 'love you' and an abrupt 'Bye'), but the formatted presentation, meta parenthetical and polished jokes make it read like a writer imitating a dad rather than a genuine spontaneous dad voicemail.
quote: "Hey, [Your Name]—it’s Dad. So, uh… we had a little possum situation here."
